purpose._: Locked expanded Home 2026-09-06 (Zillow-shaped after Redfin cut). Full-bleed search. Stacked house carousels. Illustrated doors. No Atlas, map block, town ledger, or market essay on home.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. Search is the Stage action. Photographed house rails and Buy/Sell/Invest doors follow.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all homes opens the Field.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now?
Can I buy, sell, or invest from here?

alsoWins: homes for sale bend redmond sisters sunriver

items: RESOLVED: phone-first one-off Field cards and Ledger overrides removed. Barrel SplitCardMedia cards on rails.
RESOLVED: overlapping rail. Stacked carousels replace the lonely Field grid.
RESOLVED 2026-09-06: Atlas, HomeExploreMap, town ledger, and market Instrument removed from home per Matt lock.
RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-M1): brokers section compact at 390; separate evaluator 77 on its scale, see tasteReview.openRaise for the rest of the page.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12): the hero Buy | Sell toggle's selected state was ambiguous. Selection is now carried by fill AND ink AND weight, and the unselected word is muted on the navy face; the switch is a native radio group so both panels are in the server HTML and the tab works with scripting off.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12): 'Central Oregon right now' was published inside the Homes dropdown only. It is now the #right-now band under the hero search, with its read time, and the menu no longer carries it (lib/site/chrome-live.ts).

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #right-now had no scroll-margin-top, so an anchor scroll parked the claim's ascenders under the sticky chrome at 375. V3Pulse.css now reserves calc(var(--v3-chrome-h) + var(--v3-space-md)); measured after a real /#right-now navigation the section top lands at 80px against a chrome bottom of 66px.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): the hero H1 stayed buyer-framed in Sell mode. V3Stage takes altEyebrow/altHeadline, both pairs ship in the server HTML, and app/_v3/home-hero-search.css switches them with the same tabs that switch the panels. The page still ships exactly one h1, carrying the locked buyer line.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): the #right-now rules were scaled against the largest reading, so 'listings for sale' was full width by construction. Every rule is now that count over the whole read (3,281 + 912 + 465), so the three fills tile one track and none is pinned; the arithmetic is in the trace.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): one house led two rails (3027 Polarstar Avenue on nearby and on price cuts). homeRailRows builds the narrow shelves first and the lead shelf from what is left, so a listing leads exactly one rail on the live 3,000-tile pool.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #doors 'Work with us' had no supporting line. It carries the live broker-roster count ('3 brokers who live and work here'), omitted rather than guessed when the roster read gives nothing.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #places was twelve identical empty boxes with towns and resorts undifferentiated. Two labelled runs now — TOWNS - HOUSES FOR SALE with the live active_sfr_count per town (the same figure /cities publishes) and RESORTS AND COMMUNITIES with names only, because this page holds no per-resort read — each with its own index door.
OPEN: #doors are line pictograms, not the illustrations the 2026-09-06 lock names.

OPEN: V3Footer's skyline band (object-fit cover in a fixed 10rem band) over-scales at 1440, and the Markets column runs long beside empty width. Shared footer on 118 pages; not touched from a homepage lane.

RESOLVED 2026-09-14 (SITE-97): #featured-community is the installed shadcn carousel + Card (FirmClosings form: photo, title, sourced lead figure, footer). Browse places towns are catalog Cards with live counts; resorts are a Card carousel, not empty chips.
OPEN: three consecutive rails share one form (eyebrow, heading, cards, see-all).

competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow and Redfin on a clean local brokerage door: brand H1, working search, stacked photographed house carousels with real card face, illustrated Buy/Sell/Invest, brokers, place Cards, proof.

competitiveBrief.source: design_system/public/references/homepage-v6.md + taste-catalog homepage-v6 layoutLock (Researchy / Redfin + Stripe + Stage).
competitiveBrief.productLock: live inventory in first viewport + MorphingSearch + Sell address without JS + house Card rails + featured carousel Card + place Cards with live town counts + sourced MLS line
competitiveBrief.refuse: Stock search-hero with no house photo. Cream-box search. House featured pager. Identical empty place chips. Dumping HOME_COMPETITIVE_BRIEF / homeBriefText as public copy. Lone competitiveBriefPass boolean without the beats demonstrated in shots (inventory, morph search, rails).

beats.text: The homepage opens with live inventory in the first viewport.
Search field that morphs into results. Navy on cream, no glass.
Buy / Sell as tabs with a sliding indicator on the house control.
A real Sell address field without waiting on JS.
House cards on the rail: price, address, beds/baths/sqft on the installed Card.
Search hero carries a live market or inventory signal, not only a photo bar.
Featured community cards carry sourced pulse figures.
Browse places with live town counts, not identical empty chips.

V3Pulse #right-now -- Central Oregon right now: live counts, constellation, read stamp

tasteReview.beats: Wins Zillow's Bend homepage on named live inventory in the first viewport (3,265, Oregon Data Share) and on Tetherow pulse ($1,900,000 median list, 8 sold last 30 days) versus photo-only resort tiles; loses to Zillow on search-morph completeness and to any serious brokerage homepage on first-viewport copy.

defects.finding: The first viewport body is the evaluation checklist pasted over the aerial, so a buyer reads navy-on-cream spec language instead of a market sentence.

Open search keeps a leftover aerial strip and drops a cream result list onto the house rail; on 375 the panel clips Esc, the MLS line, and the lead card instead of the field becoming the results surface.

Resorts and planned communities, Browse places, and Resorts and communities are three stacked eyebrow-heading-card rows; the lower resort rail repeats Tetherow/Broken Top as identical Resort community Cards with no pulse.
Tetherow, Broken Top, and Eagle Crest sit as photo Cards labeled only Resort community, a second community carousel that discards the pulse the featured rail just established.
See all homes on 375 wraps into a tall square beside Homes in Bend and nearby, and the first-viewport house photos are cropped to a sliver.
Caldera Springs shows 62.5 days to an offer with no source line on the Card, and Broken Top's Explore footer is clipped.

tasteReview.rebaselineReason: Mini Cursor 2026-09-14: demoMatch true, competitiveBriefPass true on the catalog evaluate land. rubricVersion v1-2026-09-08 → v1-2026-09-12 and shotsHash differ from the SITE-83 instrument; scores 52/47/55 stay the Mini three-scoring. Do not invent a new score.
tasteReview.verdict: demoMatch is true because search-open, sell-tab, featured, and places shots show morph results, a Street address field, carousel Cards with pulse and town counts, and house-home-rails with price/address/beds/baths/sqft, not chips. The page still fails as a homepage: the stacked-section rhythm plus evaluator copy in the hero keep it a catalog assembly with a live MLS badge, not a page that beats Zillow on craft or originality.
